description:
The full blueprint for one Georgia Milestones test, for pacing and coverage planning. Identify the test by `assessment_id` (e.g. 'gmas_g05_math'), by `course` for an End-of-Course test (e.g. 'biology', 'algebra i', 'us history'), or by `grade` + `subject` for an End-of-Grade test (e.g. grade='5', subject='math'). Returns `title`, `total_points`, `dok_distribution` (Depth of Knowledge split), `design` (item-type table), `claim_summary` (points per claim), and `claims`: each claim and target with its `approx_points` and the `standards` it covers.

READING THE POINTS. Do not add up `approx_points` down `claims`: the blueprint often draws one merged points cell across several target rows, and each of those rows repeats the pooled value (the naive sum reads 98-114 on the 60-point ELA tests and 82 on the 58-point grade 5 math test). Pooled rows share a `points_group` id and are flagged `points_shared: true`, with co-covered codes in `points_shared_with` and a ready-to-quote `approx_points_note`. The correct numbers are precomputed: `claim_summary` (one total per claim) and `total_claim_points` (the whole test). `total_points` comes from the design table and is null for the ELA blueprints (their PDFs have no Total row), so use `total_claim_points` there. If no single test matches, the result is an error that lists the available tests.

course.title: Course

grade.description: Grade of an End-of-Grade test (3 through 8). Use with subject.
